The February update has arrived - apologies for cutting it a bit close! My Windows laptop had a battery swelling issue and I wasn't comfortable shipping an update unless I could standy to fix any Windows issues that came up. The good news is that I'm back online now!

This update features a new enemy that will show up in the final dungeon - Cococat! Cococat was one of the deadliest and most hated enemies in the original Meteorfall: Journeys game. In Krumit's Tale, in addition to having deadly quick and piercing attacks, Cococat also punishes you on the board by causing tiles in the same row to require health to pick up.

Rounding out the update are a couple new abilities, and a new perk, Magician, that adds a 'Push' action to all of your abilities that target enemies. It can be a difficult perk to make use of, but can be used to inflict more damage with burn as Greybeard, help trigger traps as Varfa, or isolate enemies as Mischief.

We're back from holiday and have some exciting new updates for Krumit's Tale!

We partnered with out publisher, Indienova, to add a world class Chinese localization of all Krumit's lines! After listening to Krumit in English for the past couple years, it was a bit surreal (and awesome!) to hear him speak Chinese. You can check out the Chinese VO in-game by language in-game to Simplfied Chinese.

Some of the most skilled players have blazed through New Game+8 and have been asking for a new challenge. This update introduces NG+9, which adds an additional modifier. The final NG+ level, NG+10, will be added in a future update.

We've also rebalanced the earlier NG+ levels which add curses. Those NG+ levels will add curses to your deck in the 2nd and 3rd dungeon respectively, to make the first dungeon less punishing due to bad RNG.
We're also adding 4 brand new tiles to the game
New Weapon: Snowpiercer (Greybeard): 1 cost, 2 durability, 3 damage
“Piercing when attacking Frozen opponents”
New Trap: Healing Trap (Varfa, Muldorf)
"Pay 2 gold to arm this trap. Trigger: Deal 6 piercing damage split between enemies in the same row, and restore 6 health split between you and your minions"
New Armor: Widow's Grasp (Bruno, Muldorf): 3 cost, 3 durability, 4 block
“When you parry, add a copy of Spider Bite to your inventory”
New Ability: Kick (Mischief) 1 gold
"Deal 8 damage to an enemy and push them. Can't be used in battle. Exhaust"
We've also added some balance changes and reworks for some underused (or hard to use) tiles. Please see all the changes in the full patch notes below. We hope you enjoy the update!

items.text: Hi folks! We're back with another content update to celebrate the holidays!

In this new mutation, you fight through a single dungeon, surviving as long as you can. As you defeat more and more enemies, stronger enemies will begin to spawn. 'Gift' tiles will also spawn, allowing you to draft a perk mid-dungeon. How long can you survive before you're overwhelmed by a board full of bosses?

notes.title: New items: Wishing Lamp & Frost Trap

items.text: We're also adding two brand new items!
Varfa, Greybeard
Pay 1 coin to arm this trap. Trigger: Apply freeze to enemies in the same row
Neutral
Choose: Gain 1 coin, restore 3 health, or restore 1 durability to a random item in your inventory
Greybeard
When you burn or freeze an enemy, reduce the cost of weapons in the same row by 2
With Varfa out, the team has been focused on expanding out Krumit's Tale with free content update. The first update we have adds the following new features:

In this Mutation, you start out with the Privileged and Greedy perks, and gold carries over between dungeons. You'll amass a huge fortune of gold - but achieving the top score will require careful management of your resources.
Baron can be accessed when starting a new run in the Mutation menu, and will occasionally show up during the daily challenge.
(Bruno, Rose)
When you parry an attack, restore 2 health
(All heroes)
Your attack is increased by 1 against solitary enemies but your deck size is decreased by 1
We're also adding a new potion / item called Liquid Armor
(All heroes)
Use to gain 3 block this round in combat
We're already hard at work on some new items and a new Mutation for December. We hope you enjoy this new update, and be sure to let us know what you think!

releases.displayName: BETA - Another week, another Rose update

items.text: Hi folks! Thanks for all the feedback so far on Rose on the beta branch! We're so happy that you all have been enjoying Rose and we've already gotten a lot of great feedback on her mechanics.
Besides fixing bugs, we're also adding a couple of new tiles this week!

We also complete reimplemented the encyclopedia. Most importantly, we added tabs for monsters, items, abilities, and special tiles. There may be some more features we add here later, but we think it's already much better than the current implementation.
Encyclopedia has been update with tabs for different sections

RENOUNCE: Removed Renounce Light / Renounce Darkness from Rose's starting deck. Added Renounce - costs 0, restores 3 health, and always shifts you to whichever form you're not currently in. This should make it generally easier to switch between forms
EXORCISM: "Remove target blessing to destroy all non-boss enemies in the same row and column. #Exhaust"
PENANCE: "After you attack with this weapon, take 2 #piercing damage and Chosen"
You can now 'Unlock all heroes and tiles' in the Settings menu
#710 New perk icons for Chosen, Crusader
MARTYR'S ESSENCE: Rework. This card now shuffles in 3 copies of Renounce into the deck
Added visual effects when Rose transforms in battle
Added keyword: mutate (swap your starting perk for another)
#716 Salamander is grayed out after being triggered
CHILL: Reverted changes. Now only triggers when attacked by an enemy with an actual attack (not poison)
#691 Ascendance cost reduced 9->6. Cost now reduced by 1 per Blessing

#733 Soft locks should no longer occur where the enemy has more than 4 debuffs applied
Fixed various issues related to the Ghostly perk
Fixed an issue where the game would occasionally get stuck on the post dungeon reward selection screen
